description: The plot illustrates how a measured score varies with input length for four source types (Tutorials, Library Documentation, StackOverflow posts, and Github files). The x-axis is labeled “Number of Tokens,” uses a linear scale, and spans from 200 to 1000 with labeled ticks at 200-unit intervals (200, 400, 600, 800; the 1000 point is shown but not labeled). The y-axis is unlabeled, uses a linear scale, and ranges from 10 to 40 with labeled ticks at 10-unit intervals (10, 20, 30, 40). Four solid lines with circular markers are shown: the blue Tutorials line increases from about 23 at 200 tokens to about 27 at 500, reaches about 29 at 800, then is about 28 at 1000; the red Library Documentation line rises from about 26 at 200 to about 29 at 500 and about 32 at 800, then drops to about 27 at 1000; the yellow StackOverflow posts line starts highest at about 33 at 200, is about 30 at 500, then declines to about 19 at 800 and about 11 at 1000; the green Github files line increases from about 28 at 200 to about 30 at 500 and about 33 at 800, then decreases to about 29 at 1000.
